name: linear-grab
description: Point at any React element in your dev app, draft a Linear issue with AI, delegate it to the Cursor agent, and track it live — in any browser.

scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build:ext
scripts.build:lib: vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts && vite build --config vite.global.config.ts && vite build --config vite.slop.config.ts && vite build --config vite.render.config.ts && node scripts/emit-dts.mjs && cp dist/slop-scan.global.js packages/bridge/slop-scan.global.js && cp dist/slop-scan.global.js bin/slop-scan.global.js && cp dist/render-scan.global.js packages/bridge/render-scan.global.js && cp dist/render-scan.global.js bin/render-scan.global.js
